question: Capillary refill time, elicited by
question_ar: يتم استنباط وقت إعادة ملء الشعيرات الدموية بواسطة؟

options.text: Pressing over the skin for 3 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds
Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds
Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds
Pressing over the skin 10 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds
Pressing over the skin for 2 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds

correct_text: Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds
purpose_ar: يريد حفظ الطريقة القياسية لإجراء اختبار زمن الامتلاء الشعري (ضغط 5 ثوانٍ).

summary_ar: اختبار الامتلاء الشعري يُجرى بالضغط على الجلد لمدة 5 ثوانٍ.

scenes.narration: لنبدأ بهذا السؤال. يتم استنباط وقت إعادة ملء الشعيرات الدموية بواسطة؟ أمامك هذه الخيارات: Pressing over the skin for 3 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds، أو Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds، أو Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds، أو Pressing over the skin 10 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds، أو Pressing over the skin for 2 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds. لنحللها معًا.

scenes.caption: لماذا كل خيار صحيح أو خاطئ
scenes.narration: لنراجع الخيارات الخاطئة واحدًا واحدًا. الخيار A، Pressing over the skin for 3 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds: لا يتوافق مع معطيات هذا السؤال؛ الإجابة الصحيحة هي Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds. يصبح صحيحًا في سؤال يصف Pressing for 3 seconds with 2-second return, 5 seconds with 5-second return, and 2 seconds with 5-second return all misstate the standard technique compared to the correct 5-second press with 2-second return. الخيار C، Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds: لا يتوافق مع معطيات هذا السؤال؛ الإجابة الصحيحة هي Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds. يصبح صحيحًا في سؤال يصف Pressing for 3 seconds with 2-second return, 5 seconds with 5-second return, and 2 seconds with 5-second return all misstate the standard technique compared to the correct 5-second press with 2-second return. الخيار D، Pressing over the skin 10 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds: لا يتوافق مع معطيات هذا السؤال؛ الإجابة الصحيحة هي Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds. يصبح صحيحًا في سؤال يصف 10-second press with 5-second return and 2-second press with 5-second return don't match the standard technique — capillary refill is tested by pressing the skin for about 5 seconds, with normal perfusion returning within about 2 seconds. الخيار E، Pressing over the skin for 2 seconds, normally return perfusion by 5 seconds: لا يتوافق مع معطيات هذا السؤال؛ الإجابة الصحيحة هي Pressing over the skin for 5 seconds, normally return perfusion by 2 seconds. يصبح صحيحًا في سؤال يصف 10-second press with 5-second return and 2-second press with 5-second return don't match the standard technique — capillary refill is tested by pressing the skin for about 5 seconds, with normal perfusion returning within about 2 seconds.
